accessibility.evidence: Original SVGs are decorative with visible text labels; rarity controls retain pressed state, 44px targets and keyboard focus. Five legendary effects stop visual motion under prefers-reduced-motion, and mute suppresses their audio. See measurements.json and legendary-effects.json.

responsive.evidence: 15 pages at three target widths have no horizontal overflow; 2–32768 numeral bounds fit all 20 skins, including 210px boards. Numeral plates were widened and long character-tile labels scaled after visual inspection.

loading.evidence: Lobby connection states render inside the same frame; guest/account checks retain their pending feedback. Test sockets for page screenshots were aborted to avoid public matchmaking.

empty.evidence: History guest/empty guidance and owned-only rarity empty state retain readable text and actions; covered by loadout.browser.mjs.

error.evidence: Account save failure leaves the previous selection intact; retry succeeds. Locale-cookie failure also preserves the previous choice; covered by profile-icons.browser.mjs and settings-language.browser.mjs.

partial.evidence: Filtering to another rarity leaves the equipped selection visible; two clients can have different themes. Shared snapshots preserve each participant skin through reconnect and end.

success.evidence: All eleven newly added skins save and survive reload; each rarity contains five; legendary merge animation/audio run in the actual tutorial.

permission.evidence: Guest locked cards still show sign-in unlock guidance and owned-only filtering retains defaults; ranked lobby retains sign-in action. Authenticated account behavior uses isolated fixtures.
